angle: Unlike rule-list treatments, this video derives each differentiation rule from its own picture: stacked bars for sums, an adjustable box area for products, and three stacked number lines for composition.
angle_detail: If time is short, take [08:41] through [12:47] first, since the composition walkthrough is the chain-rule intuition backprop will assume, then go back to [04:11] through [08:06] for the product area. Critical pitfall: despite the L15 header this video contains zero neural-network content, so file it as calculus preparation, not L15 coverage. The closing stretch from [14:48] warns that watching never substitutes for doing the computations yourself.
review_recommendation: Recommend keeping unit unit-m2-sad-l15 with depth derivation and scope prerequisite: the video teaches no listed L15 node and only prepares knowledge-sad-l15-backprop. Evidence: it asks for "the derivative of their composition".
